table.name: TLGNR_MIME_TYPE_BS
table.description: List of MIME types supported by LOGON, for example for BLOB data stored in the database.

column.name: MIME_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data.

column.name: MIME_TYPE
column.description: Name of the MIME type as understood by a browser, e.g. 'image/png' or 'application/pdf'.

column.name: FILE_EXTENSION
column.description: Default file extension to use when creating a filename of this type, for example 'pdf' or 'gif' (excl. separator).

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
